root: ^This young man seems athletic and sure of himself, but you see the mark of a tired person in him.

s: ^Hi, I'm the train conductor, what's your name?

c-0: ^He sits back right up. Pavel Naumova, nice to meet you. He pronounce words in a weird way but you can't lay your finger on it.
^I'm from Włocła, on the northern border. Not many people knows about it, it's a small village.

s: ^ah so that's were your accent is coming from!
^on the northern border ? I'm sorry to hear that, I guess Włocła was one of the first to fall to the SRUR...

c-0: ^My accent? He looks a bit confused ah, yeah I guess. I... never thought about it.
c-1: ^yeah, well before the war many folks were coming from both side of the border, we kind of mix with the Raïshurians.

s: ^doesn't it bother you to be mixed with cruel invaders?

c-0: ^He's speaking with more energy than usual it's the raïshurian government the problem, not the people ! Most of them are forced to go to war.

s: ^if they didn't want to kill innocent people they could juste have turn the rifles back to their own government.

c-0: ^That's easy to say, and what are you doing for your country? Are you taking up the arms against the invader ? No, you're fleeing because you're not a soldier, and you fear death like most.

s: ^really? I didn't know that about Raïshurians.

c-0: ^Well when you're on the border you hear them talk. If you knew how many of them felt about it...

s: ^you speak Raïshurian? That could be useful if we meet soldiers.

c-0: ^He's startled by your response yeah no, I understand it better than I speak it. Beside soldiers and I don't get along...
^I needed to move quickly, to left behind this senseless war.
c-1: ^Yes, in my hometown. My father is a wealty man and my mother is sweet, I will miss her very much.

s: ^it's always hard to leave without a chance to say goodbye.

c-0: ^Yes, but sometime it's better that way.

s: ^You couldn't take your family with you?
^What will you do in the neutral zone ?

c-0: ^I... don't know. Find a job and live a peacefull life I guess.

^This young man has a lot in his mind, he's tortured by it. He doesn't mix well with other, and seems to have something heavy to carry with him. You pity him, as war tend to create broken people like him by thousands.
